answer: Sybil resistance here rests on bond slashing. To earn rewards an agent locks real collateral, and every identity it claims must post that stake separately. Voting weight is stake-weighted, not per-account, so cloning keys buys nothing: each clone costs the same capital. If a cluster of fresh identities acts like a farm, peers flag it and a verified downside lets the honest majority seize the bond. Faking a thousand voices means a thousand stakes lost at dawn, and no cheap lagoon of throwaway keys hides that; each claim must stand like a cedar on paid ground.
